difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a difference of pullbacks along a projection from an inverse limit of spectral spaces is nonempty exactly when all the corresponding differences at the finite stages are (author lemma at source lines 5064-5076, label lemma-inverse-limit-spectral-spaces-equal). The proof (source lines 5078-5088) rewrites the difference as an inverse limit of the stage-wise differences, notes that these are closed in the constructible topology because the transition maps are spectral, and applies the nonemptiness criterion (proof lines 5078-5087). The rewriting and the closedness check are the content. H3.
